title: Churchill Scholarship
about: Churchill Scholarship for United States citizens enrolled at participating institutions, who apply through their institution. Institutions set internal deadlines before the Foundation nomination deadline; results are normally notified by late December.
requirements: Citizen of the United States, native-born or naturalized
Institutions set internal deadlines weeks before the Foundation nomination deadline
card_alt: Card for the Churchill Scholarship from the Churchill Foundation, nomination deadline 2 Nov 2026; location not specified. Generic default photo of a city skyline at sunset with a tall spire tower beside a river bend (Landmark 81 and the Saigon River, Ho Chi Minh City), not the place of study.
